faq.q: Which Tsawwassen areas appear on this page?
faq.a: The page's own cards in the base research were labelled Boundary Beach, Tsawwassen East, Beach Grove, Cliff Drive, Tsawwassen North, Pebble Hill and English Bluff — feed labels only, not a price claim about any sub-area.

faq.q: What should I check on a bluff or waterfront home in this band?
faq.a: Which hazard Development Permit Area applies: SD2 English Bluff (Tsawwassen Escarpment) or SD3 Boundary Bay Foreshore and the Southlands, where SD3 sets a 2.9 m floor level, a 2.3 m minimum land surface elevation and a 7.5 m tidal setback; and, on farm-edge lots, the parcel's ALR status on the Agricultural Land Commission's maps.

faq.q: Can I add a suite or coach house to a house in Tsawwassen?
faq.a: BC's small-scale multi-unit housing rules allow more homes on many urban lots, but each municipality sets the details and many lots are excluded. Check the lot's zoning with the municipality before you plan a suite or coach house.

faq.q: Do I need a home inspection when buying in Tsawwassen?
faq.a: It is strongly recommended. Make the offer subject to an inspection so a qualified inspector can look at the roof, structure, drainage, electrical and heating before you remove conditions.
